scope: PERF-01: all 15 A/B pairs in each of two separate forward/reverse blocks; 13 Zendiator cases and 2 unchanged Immediate controls.

adoptionDecision.basis: The user explicitly accepted the measured ScopeK1 and warm Send5 benefits together with the retained regressions, allocation tradeoff and unresolved cause.
adoptionDecision.exception: PERF-01 was adopted by explicit user judgment despite the reverse Send0.ResolveSend common-set regression. The original classifications and gate result remain unchanged.
adoptionDecision.scopeK1TimeAndAllocationCap: passed in both blocks: faster than same-block candidate Immediate with disjoint intervals, and 624 B <= 704 B
adoptionDecision.scopeK1MinimumAllocationEffortGoal: not met: 624 B versus Immediate 568 B, a remaining 56 B difference
adoptionDecision.versionBoundary: Both measured revisions identify product version 0.6.0. Adoption targets the next 0.7.0 minor version. These measurements do not measure a newly versioned 0.7.0 package; the adopted performance implementation is the measured ca465fc candidate, with version/documentation changes recorded separately.
adoptionDecision.publicationBoundary: This decision record does not itself merge a PR or release a package.

conditions.fixedInvocationException: Requested iteration duration is not enforced for FirstSend and ColdOuterFailure.
conditions.profile: Release; affinity 1; 20 warmup; 12 measurement; 500 ms requested iteration; 1 launch

denominators.correctnessGates: Separate from timing denominators: existing UseCase389 + struct96; Hook18; Short6

classificationRule: Only non-overlapping confidence intervals count as improvement/regression; overlap remains overlap regardless of mean direction. Raw confidence Level is a BDN enum value, not a percent.
percentConvention: 100 * (candidateMean / baselineMean - 1); negative means lower observed time.
pooling: None: forward and reverse remain separate; no block or case discarded.

scopeK1VsSameBlockCandidateImmediate.ratioConvention: candidate Zendiator mean divided by same-block candidate Immediate mean; allocation delta uses the same reference
candidate Zendiator mean divided by same-block candidate Immediate mean; allocation delta uses the same reference

artifactPathConvention: Each result's reportPath is relative to artifactRoots[forward/reverse] selected by its containing block. Audit receipt paths are relative to artifactRoots.validation. These retained raw bundles have not been published.

diagnostics.selectedManagedMethods: Saved-child ResolveSend0 route, getter and benchmark methods, and Immediate ScopeK10/ScopeMany methods have equal normalized IL and implementation flags across baseline/candidate.
diagnostics.sameSideBlockIdentity: Selected saved consumer, Zendiator and Abstractions DLL hashes are stable within each side across the forward and reverse blocks.
diagnostics.causalityLimit: Equal managed IL does not rule out indirect effects from changed enclosing types, metadata, native JIT code, DI lookup/hash layout or machine state. The ResolveSend0 and unchanged Immediate ScopeK10 differences have no confirmed cause.
diagnostics.oldAaCorrection: The earlier ab-smoke used the same source revision on both sides but different measured consumer/product DLL bytes. It is same-source rebuild A/A, not same-binary A/A, and does not establish a same-binary noise bound.

limitations: The prior strict common non-regression gate was not passed; explicit user acceptance is an exception, not a reclassification of the measured regression.
Reverse Send0.ResolveSend rises from 25.94383843630448 to 29.949775655464062 ns with disjoint intervals; forward overlaps. This result is retained.
Unchanged Immediate ScopeK10 regresses in both orders, by 14.728131% and 16.238053% in observed means. Its cause is unresolved; do not attribute every other improvement to the product change.
Only ScopeK1, warm Typed Send5 and ScopeK10 improve with disjoint intervals in both blocks. No Zendiator case regresses in both; one regresses in reverse only.
Observed block-to-block changes are descriptive, not a pooled estimate, additional controlled effect or explanation.
One machine and one launch per timed cell do not establish a universal ranking. Allocation and time are evaluated separately.
Correctness and saved-consumer gates are separate from timing denominators and from the performance adoption decision.
The complete raw consumer bundles and private diagnostic snapshots have not been published. This public file is a portable numeric/provenance index with relative paths and original SHA256 anchors.
Native AOT package checks do not establish Native AOT performance, and these values must not be labeled measurements of the newly versioned 0.7.0 package.
